shape_example.note: Each microbatch gathers matching row slices from all4 CP ranks. It is not4 independent requests, nor4 new PP stages. Late bounded-tail32 rows fail MIN_ROWS and do not use this path.

functions.name: _c007_wo_ok / c007_front_mode
functions.role: Eligibility for deferring output projection and reusing next-layer Q front; plain mode excludes fused QK norm/rope, head norm, unified KV, breakable graph, fused O-attn, Q-B row permutation.

functions.name: c007_front_step
functions.role: Next-layer per-row wqkv_a, q_norm, wq_b, Q RoPE into persistent pre buffers; first part also fills KV-A portion via fused qkv projection, but does not perform next-layer KV store or attention.

functions.name: c007_wo
functions.role: Per-row O-A BF16 BMM then O-B; original model precision unchanged.

functions.name: C004/C007 env and communication stream
functions.role: MB/MIN_ROWS/FP8/Shared/EPI/QAHEAD flags and lazily created side torch.cuda.Stream; actual priority -1.

functions.name: forward_hc_pre_from_prev C007 entry and prior Q-front consumption
functions.role: Uses _c007_pre_in only if hidden/residual identity matches, no stats/aux path; sets self_attn._c007_pre; defers output projection; enters C007 direct path.

functions.name: _c004_fp8_ok
functions.role: Requires MXFP4 FlashInfer CUTLASS with MXFP8 scaling, global weight scales, nonfused shared expert, standard FP4 expert routing and no waterfill.

functions.name: _c004_pack
functions.role: Local gate/topk and MXFP8 quantization; one uint8 row [Q | UE8M0 scale | topk weights | topk ids].

functions.name: _c004_moe_packed
functions.role: Unpacks gathered buffer, constructs StandardTopKOutput, prequantized experts FC1/FC2 and routed scale. Shared can be local and added after RS.

functions.name: _moe_ffn_cp_pipelined
functions.role: Basic C004 gather/MoE/RS pipeline. The normal dispatch gate later excludes shared_expert_tp1, so this is not the actual current shared-TP1 C007 entry.

functions.name: _c007_ok
functions.role: EPI on, MB>1, equal split, CP path, A2A none, attnDP1, local rows>=1024, no hash, no stream capture, FP8 pack and O projection supported, no megamhc/stats stream.

functions.name: _moe_ffn_cp_pipelined_c007
functions.role: Actual whole-row-pipelined epilogue + MoE + local shared + closing post + optional next-Q-front.

functions.name: _c007_front_begin
functions.role: Next-layer buffers; skips engram, unsupported Q front and stats stream.

functions.name: _run_moe_ffn_dp_sync
functions.role: C004 base gate requires no replicated TP1 shared expert; otherwise whole hidden BF16 gather, experts, RS and local shared add. MB1 cannot enter C007 and takes this larger-payload fallback.

functions.name: _forward_prepare cached Q-front consumption
functions.role: Reuses precomputed fused qkv_a instead of recomputing it; rows2370..2377 reuse q_lora/Q while normal KV-store/indexer/attention preparation still executes.

functions.name: attention pre-wo deferral
functions.role: Returns pre-projection [T,G,D] output to decoder for C007 row epilogue.

functions.name: next-layer selection
functions.role: Same PP stage only (_j<end_layer), no DSPARK capture, next layer has no engram, no transition to bounded tail.

lanes.main: O-A/O-B, mHC, router/quant/pack, expert FC1/SwiGLU/FC2, local Shared, closing mHC, optional next-Q-front; all same current compute stream
lanes.comm: MoE AG and RS share one side stream; not mutually parallel

loop: M_i on gathered packed rows; record compute_done[i]
comm wait compute_done[i]; enqueue RS_i; record rs_done[i]
if i+2 exists: prepare(i+2); enqueue G(i+2)
local_shared(i) on this rank local rows on main
drain: After all microbatch MoE/shared operations have been submitted to main, second loop iterates i0..3
add local_shared(i) to out_i; closing mHC post_i
optional next-layer combine/norm, QKV-A, Q norm, Q-B and Q RoPE for slice_i
C007_logical_execution.important: QAahead/closing post does not execute before earlier queued main operations. It can overlap remaining tail RS, not interleave arbitrary Q0 before M1/M2. Attention itself, its indexer and global KV dependencies are not advanced by this front step.
C007_logical_execution.buffer_lifetime: record_stream(comm) on outputs/sources/gathered/compute outputs prevents caching allocator reuse before the side-stream consumers finish; not an extra synchronization barrier.
C007_logical_execution.correctness: _every_row_routed temporarily exposes all gathered real rows to the MoE; mlp_reduce_scatter=True prevents an extra post-experts allreduce before outer RS.

trace_lane_confirmation.basis: 52 same-input CPU record_param_comms API records matched to52 native AllGather GPU events by complete collective sequence; Byte21,823,488 is40 MoE, Byte9,584,640 is10 SWA, Float16,777,216 is2 Compressor. No nearest-time pairing.

unverified_items: C006_MOE_GEMM_SMS=180 environment exists, but this source audit did not inspect its FlashInfer consumer. Do not infer a guaranteed reserved-SM count or preemption from the flag alone.
interpretation_limits: SGLang scheduler overlap / TBO / SBO are distinct from this model-internal custom C004/C007 patch. A False scheduler/TBO flag does not disable these explicit CUDA stream operations.
The measured MB4/EPI1/QAHEAD1 vs MB1/EPI0/QAHEAD0 comparison changes both scheduling and gather format; it is not a single-variable microbatch-ablation experiment.
